NBA DFS Picks for Wednesday, October 21 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Wednesday, October 21 · 11 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 21, 8:26 PM ET

Luka Doncic (LAL) is the top-projected player on the Wednesday, October 21 DraftKings main slate at 59.7 DraftKings points for $11,000. Giannis Antetokounmpo (MIA, 56.6, $10,000) and Jalen Johnson (ATL, 48.5, $9,000) are next.

Dennis Schroder (CHA) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 7.19 projected points per $1,000 at $3,700.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 21, 8:26 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
